servers.name: langfuse-docs
servers.description: Public MCP server for the Langfuse documentation. Search the docs, fetch individual pages, and get a high-level overview of Langfuse.

servers.name: langfuse
servers.description: Authenticated MCP server for Langfuse data (prompts, datasets, scores, observations, metrics, and more). Each API key pair is scoped to one project; send it as an HTTP Basic Authorization header (public key as username, secret key as password). This URL is Cloud EU; the other regions are https://us.cloud.langfuse.com/api/public/mcp, https://jp.cloud.langfuse.com/api/public/mcp, and https://hipaa.cloud.langfuse.com/api/public/mcp. Self-hosted deployments serve it at /api/public/mcp.

langfuse-docs.description: Search Langfuse documentation, fetch individual doc pages, and get a high-level overview of Langfuse.

langfuse.description: Read and write Langfuse data (prompts, datasets, scores, observations, metrics, and more) for one project. Authenticate with an HTTP Basic Authorization header built from a project API key pair. Cloud EU endpoint; see https://langfuse.com/docs/api-and-data-platform/features/mcp-server for other regions and the full tool list.
